#MAD 
```{r}
# ==========================================================
# FIBER PHOTOMETRY TRANSIENT ANALYSIS
# MAD-BASED PEAK COUNTS
#
# Separate Poisson GLMMs for:
#   Hab
#   Social
#   Novel
#
# Outcome:
#   n_peaks
#
# Fixed effect:
#   timepoint
#
# Random intercept:
#   mouse_id
#
# Offset:
#   log(duration_s)
#
# Post hoc:
#   Dunnett:
#     W1 vs Preinduction
#     W2 vs Preinduction
# ==========================================================


# ==========================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ==========================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)


# ==========================================================
# 2. IMPORT DATA
# ==========================================================

df <- read.csv(
  "MAD_whole_trial_peak_data_for_R.csv"
)


# ==========================================================
# 3. PREPARE DATA
# ==========================================================

df <- df %>%

  mutate(

    mouse_id =
      factor(mouse_id),

    trial_type =
      factor(
        trial_type,
        levels = c(
          "Hab",
          "Social",
          "Novel"
        )
      ),

    timepoint =
      factor(
        timepoint,
        levels = c(
          "Preinduction",
          "W1",
          "W2"
        )
      ),

    n_peaks =
      as.integer(n_peaks),

    duration_s =
      as.numeric(duration_s)

  ) %>%

  filter(

    trial_type %in%
      c(
        "Hab",
        "Social",
        "Novel"
      ),

    timepoint %in%
      c(
        "Preinduction",
        "W1",
        "W2"
      ),

    !is.na(n_peaks),

    !is.na(duration_s),

    duration_s > 0

  ) %>%

  droplevels()


# ==========================================================
# 4. DATA CHECKS
# ==========================================================

cat(
  "\n====================================================\n",
  "MAD DATA CHECK\n",
  "====================================================\n"
)

print(
  table(
    df$trial_type,
    df$timepoint
  )
)

cat(
  "\nNumber of mice:",
  n_distinct(df$mouse_id),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "\nPeak counts:\n"
)

print(
  summary(df$n_peaks)
)

cat(
  "\nRecording durations:\n"
)

print(
  summary(df$duration_s)
)


# ==========================================================
# 5. DESCRIPTIVES
# ==========================================================

descriptive_MAD <- df %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type,
    timepoint
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n_mice =
      n_distinct(mouse_id),

    mean_peaks =
      mean(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_peaks =
      sd(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sem_peaks =
      sd_peaks /
      sqrt(n_mice),

    median_peaks =
      median(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_duration_s =
      mean(
        duration_s,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )


print(
  descriptive_MAD
)


write.csv(
  descriptive_MAD,
  "MAD_descriptive_statistics.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 6. ANALYSIS FUNCTION
# ==========================================================

run_poisson_MAD <- function(
  data,
  trial_name
) {


  cat(
    "\n\n====================================================\n",
    trial_name,
    " - MAD\n",
    "====================================================\n"
  )


  d <- data %>%

    filter(
      trial_type ==
        trial_name
    ) %>%

    droplevels()


  print(
    d %>%
      select(
        mouse_id,
        timepoint,
        n_peaks,
        duration_s
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        mouse_id,
        timepoint
      )
  )


  # ========================================================
  # FULL POISSON GLMM
  # ========================================================

  model_full <- glmer(

    n_peaks ~

      timepoint +

      offset(
        log(duration_s)
      ) +

      (
        1 |
        mouse_id
      ),

    family =
      poisson(
        link = "log"
      ),

    data =
      d,

    control =
      glmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa"
      )

  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "MODEL SUMMARY\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    summary(model_full)
  )


  # ========================================================
  # SINGULAR FIT CHECK
  # ========================================================

  singular_fit <- isSingular(
    model_full,
    tol = 1e-4
  )


  cat(
    "\nSingular fit:",
    singular_fit,
    "\n"
  )


  # ========================================================
  # DISPERSION
  # ========================================================

  pearson_residuals <- residuals(
    model_full,
    type = "pearson"
  )


  pearson_chisq <- sum(
    pearson_residuals^2
  )


  residual_df <-
    nrow(d) -
    length(
      fixef(model_full)
    )


  dispersion_ratio <-
    pearson_chisq /
    residual_df


  dispersion_p <- pchisq(

    pearson_chisq,

    df =
      residual_df,

    lower.tail =
      FALSE
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "DISPERSION CHECK\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Dispersion ratio:",
    round(
      dispersion_ratio,
      3
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Approximate p-value:",
    round(
      dispersion_p,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  # ========================================================
  # NULL MODEL
  # ========================================================

  model_null <- glmer(

    n_peaks ~

      offset(
        log(duration_s)
      ) +

      (
        1 |
        mouse_id
      ),

    family =
      poisson(
        link = "log"
      ),

    data =
      d,

    control =
      glmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa"
      )

  )


  # ========================================================
  # OVERALL TIMEPOINT TEST
  # ========================================================

  overall_test <- anova(

    model_null,
    model_full,

    test =
      "Chisq"
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "OVERALL TIMEPOINT TEST\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    overall_test
  )


  # ========================================================
  # ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS
  # ========================================================

  emm <- emmeans(

    model_full,

    ~ timepoint,

    type =
      "response"
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    emm
  )


  # ========================================================
  # DUNNETT POST HOC
  #
  # Preinduction = reference
  # ========================================================

  dunnett_results <- contrast(

    emm,

    method =
      "trt.vs.ctrl",

    ref =
      1,

    adjust =
      "dunnettx"
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "DUNNETT POST HOC TEST\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    dunnett_results
  )


  # ========================================================
  # SAVE MODEL
  # ========================================================

  saveRDS(

    model_full,

    paste0(
      "MAD_",
      trial_name,
      "_Poisson_model.rds"
    )
  )


  # ========================================================
  # RETURN
  # ========================================================

  list(

    data =
      d,

    model =
      model_full,

    null_model =
      model_null,

    overall =
      overall_test,

    emm =
      emm,

    dunnett =
      dunnett_results,

    dispersion_ratio =
      dispersion_ratio,

    dispersion_p =
      dispersion_p,

    singular =
      singular_fit
  )
}


# ==========================================================
# 7. RUN MODELS
# ==========================================================

hab_MAD <- run_poisson_MAD(
  df,
  "Hab"
)


social_MAD <- run_poisson_MAD(
  df,
  "Social"
)


novel_MAD <- run_poisson_MAD(
  df,
  "Novel"
)


# ==========================================================
# 8. DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

diagnostics_MAD <- tibble(

  trial_type =
    c(
      "Hab",
      "Social",
      "Novel"
    ),

  dispersion_ratio =
    c(
      hab_MAD$dispersion_ratio,
      social_MAD$dispersion_ratio,
      novel_MAD$dispersion_ratio
    ),

  dispersion_p =
    c(
      hab_MAD$dispersion_p,
      social_MAD$dispersion_p,
      novel_MAD$dispersion_p
    ),

  singular_fit =
    c(
      hab_MAD$singular,
      social_MAD$singular,
      novel_MAD$singular
    )
)


print(
  diagnostics_MAD
)


write.csv(
  diagnostics_MAD,
  "MAD_Poisson_diagnostics.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 9. DUNNETT RESULTS
# ==========================================================

dunnett_MAD <- bind_rows(

  as.data.frame(
    hab_MAD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Hab"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    social_MAD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Social"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    novel_MAD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Novel"
    )

) %>%

  select(
    trial_type,
    everything()
  )


print(
  dunnett_MAD
)


write.csv(
  dunnett_MAD,
  "MAD_Poisson_Dunnett_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 10. ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS
# ==========================================================

emm_MAD <- bind_rows(

  as.data.frame(
    hab_MAD$emm
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Hab"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    social_MAD$emm
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Social"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    novel_MAD$emm
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Novel"
    )

) %>%

  select(
    trial_type,
    everything()
  )


write.csv(
  emm_MAD,
  "MAD_Poisson_estimated_marginal_means.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. PLOT SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

plot_summary_MAD <- df %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type,
    timepoint
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    mean_peaks =
      mean(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_peaks =
      sd(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    n_mice =
      n_distinct(mouse_id),

    sem_peaks =
      sd_peaks /
      sqrt(n_mice),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )


# ==========================================================
# 12. PREPARE P-VALUES FOR PLOT
# ==========================================================

p_MAD <- bind_rows(

  as.data.frame(
    hab_MAD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Hab"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    social_MAD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Social"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    novel_MAD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Novel"
    )

) %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    comparison_number =
      row_number()

  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  mutate(

    p_label = case_when(

      p.value < 0.001 ~
        "p < .001",

      p.value < 0.01 ~
        paste0(
          "p = ",
          sub(
            "^0",
            "",
            sprintf(
              "%.3f",
              p.value
            )
          )
        ),

      TRUE ~
        paste0(
          "p = ",
          sub(
            "^0",
            "",
            sprintf(
              "%.2f",
              p.value
            )
          )
        )
    )
  )


# ==========================================================
# 13. BRACKET HEIGHTS
# ==========================================================

plot_heights_MAD <- df %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    ymax =
      max(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    ymin =
      min(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    yrange =
      ymax - ymin,

    yrange =
      ifelse(
        yrange == 0,
        max(
          ymax * 0.2,
          1
        ),
        yrange
      ),

    y_w1 =
      ymax +
      0.15 * yrange,

    y_w2 =
      ymax +
      0.40 * yrange

  )


p_MAD <- p_MAD %>%

  left_join(
    plot_heights_MAD,
    by =
      "trial_type"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    x_start =
      1,

    x_end =
      ifelse(
        comparison_number == 1,
        2,
        3
      ),

    y_position =
      ifelse(
        comparison_number == 1,
        y_w1,
        y_w2
      ),

    text_x =
      (
        x_start +
        x_end
      ) /
      2,

    bracket_height =
      0.04 *
      yrange
  )


# ==========================================================
# 14. PLOT
# ==========================================================

plot_MAD <- ggplot() +

  geom_line(

    data =
      df,

    aes(
      x =
        timepoint,
      y =
        n_peaks,
      group =
        mouse_id
    ),

    alpha =
      0.35,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(

    data =
      df,

    aes(
      x =
        timepoint,
      y =
        n_peaks
    ),

    size =
      2,

    alpha =
      0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(

    data =
      plot_summary_MAD,

    aes(
      x =
        timepoint,
      y =
        mean_peaks
    ),

    size =
      4
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(

    data =
      plot_summary_MAD,

    aes(

      x =
        timepoint,

      ymin =
        mean_peaks -
        sem_peaks,

      ymax =
        mean_peaks +
        sem_peaks

    ),

    width =
      0.1,

    linewidth =
      0.8
  ) +

  # Horizontal brackets
  geom_segment(

    data =
      p_MAD,

    aes(
      x =
        x_start,
      xend =
        x_end,
      y =
        y_position,
      yend =
        y_position
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  # Left bracket ends
  geom_segment(

    data =
      p_MAD,

    aes(
      x =
        x_start,
      xend =
        x_start,
      y =
        y_position,
      yend =
        y_position -
        bracket_height
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  # Right bracket ends
  geom_segment(

    data =
      p_MAD,

    aes(
      x =
        x_end,
      xend =
        x_end,
      y =
        y_position,
      yend =
        y_position -
        bracket_height
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  # Adjusted Dunnett p-values
  geom_text(

    data =
      p_MAD,

    aes(
      x =
        text_x,
      y =
        y_position +
        0.05 *
        yrange,
      label =
        p_label
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    size =
      3.7
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ trial_type,
    scales =
      "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(

    expand =
      expansion(
        mult =
          c(
            0.05,
            0.30
          )
      )
  ) +

  labs(

    x =
      "Timepoint",

    y =
      "Number of detected transients",

    title =
      "MAD-based transient counts"

  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size =
      13
  )


print(
  plot_MAD
)


ggsave(

  filename =
    "MAD_Poisson_peak_counts_with_Dunnett_pvalues.png",

  plot =
    plot_MAD,

  width =
    10,

  height =
    4.5,

  dpi =
    300
)


cat(
  "\nMAD ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# FIBER PHOTOMETRY TRANSIENT ANALYSIS
# SD-BASED PEAK COUNTS
#
# Separate Poisson GLMMs for:
#   Hab
#   Social
#   Novel
#
# Outcome:
#   n_peaks
#
# Fixed effect:
#   timepoint
#
# Random intercept:
#   mouse_id
#
# Offset:
#   log(duration_s)
#
# Post hoc:
#   Dunnett:
#     W1 vs Preinduction
#     W2 vs Preinduction
# ==========================================================


# ==========================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ==========================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)


# ==========================================================
# 2. IMPORT DATA
# ==========================================================

df <- read.csv(
  "whole_trial_peak_data_for_R_SD.csv"
)


# ==========================================================
# 3. PREPARE DATA
# ==========================================================

df <- df %>%

  mutate(

    mouse_id =
      factor(mouse_id),

    trial_type =
      factor(
        trial_type,
        levels =
          c(
            "Hab",
            "Social",
            "Novel"
          )
      ),

    timepoint =
      factor(
        timepoint,
        levels =
          c(
            "Preinduction",
            "W1",
            "W2"
          )
      ),

    n_peaks =
      as.integer(
        n_peaks
      ),

    duration_s =
      as.numeric(
        duration_s
      )

  ) %>%

  filter(

    trial_type %in%
      c(
        "Hab",
        "Social",
        "Novel"
      ),

    timepoint %in%
      c(
        "Preinduction",
        "W1",
        "W2"
      ),

    !is.na(
      n_peaks
    ),

    !is.na(
      duration_s
    ),

    duration_s >
      0

  ) %>%

  droplevels()


# ==========================================================
# 4. DATA CHECKS
# ==========================================================

cat(
  "\n====================================================\n",
  "SD DATA CHECK\n",
  "====================================================\n"
)


print(
  table(
    df$trial_type,
    df$timepoint
  )
)


cat(
  "\nNumber of mice:",
  n_distinct(
    df$mouse_id
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nPeak counts:\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    df$n_peaks
  )
)


cat(
  "\nRecording durations:\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    df$duration_s
  )
)


# ==========================================================
# 5. DESCRIPTIVES
# ==========================================================

descriptive_SD <- df %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type,
    timepoint
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n_mice =
      n_distinct(
        mouse_id
      ),

    mean_peaks =
      mean(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    sd_peaks =
      sd(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    sem_peaks =
      sd_peaks /
      sqrt(
        n_mice
      ),

    median_peaks =
      median(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    mean_duration_s =
      mean(
        duration_s,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )


print(
  descriptive_SD
)


write.csv(
  descriptive_SD,
  "SD_descriptive_statistics.csv",
  row.names =
    FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 6. ANALYSIS FUNCTION
# ==========================================================

run_poisson_SD <- function(
  data,
  trial_name
) {


  cat(
    "\n\n====================================================\n",
    trial_name,
    " - SD\n",
    "====================================================\n"
  )


  d <- data %>%

    filter(
      trial_type ==
        trial_name
    ) %>%

    droplevels()


  print(
    d %>%

      select(
        mouse_id,
        timepoint,
        n_peaks,
        duration_s
      ) %>%

      arrange(
        mouse_id,
        timepoint
      )
  )


  # ========================================================
  # FULL POISSON GLMM
  # ========================================================

  model_full <- glmer(

    n_peaks ~

      timepoint +

      offset(
        log(
          duration_s
        )
      ) +

      (
        1 |
        mouse_id
      ),

    family =
      poisson(
        link =
          "log"
      ),

    data =
      d,

    control =
      glmerControl(
        optimizer =
          "bobyqa"
      )

  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "MODEL SUMMARY\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    summary(
      model_full
    )
  )


  # ========================================================
  # SINGULAR FIT CHECK
  # ========================================================

  singular_fit <- isSingular(

    model_full,

    tol =
      1e-4
  )


  cat(
    "\nSingular fit:",
    singular_fit,
    "\n"
  )


  # ========================================================
  # DISPERSION
  # ========================================================

  pearson_residuals <- residuals(

    model_full,

    type =
      "pearson"
  )


  pearson_chisq <- sum(
    pearson_residuals^2
  )


  residual_df <-

    nrow(
      d
    ) -

    length(
      fixef(
        model_full
      )
    )


  dispersion_ratio <-

    pearson_chisq /
    residual_df


  dispersion_p <- pchisq(

    pearson_chisq,

    df =
      residual_df,

    lower.tail =
      FALSE
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "DISPERSION CHECK\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Dispersion ratio:",
    round(
      dispersion_ratio,
      3
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Approximate p-value:",
    round(
      dispersion_p,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  # ========================================================
  # NULL MODEL
  # ========================================================

  model_null <- glmer(

    n_peaks ~

      offset(
        log(
          duration_s
        )
      ) +

      (
        1 |
        mouse_id
      ),

    family =
      poisson(
        link =
          "log"
      ),

    data =
      d,

    control =
      glmerControl(
        optimizer =
          "bobyqa"
      )

  )


  # ========================================================
  # OVERALL TIMEPOINT TEST
  # ========================================================

  overall_test <- anova(

    model_null,
    model_full,

    test =
      "Chisq"
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "OVERALL TIMEPOINT TEST\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    overall_test
  )


  # ========================================================
  # ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS
  # ========================================================

  emm <- emmeans(

    model_full,

    ~ timepoint,

    type =
      "response"
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    emm
  )


  # ========================================================
  # DUNNETT POST HOC
  # ========================================================

  dunnett_results <- contrast(

    emm,

    method =
      "trt.vs.ctrl",

    ref =
      1,

    adjust =
      "dunnettx"
  )


  cat(
    "\n-----------------------------\n",
    "DUNNETT POST HOC TEST\n",
    "-----------------------------\n"
  )


  print(
    dunnett_results
  )


  # ========================================================
  # SAVE MODEL
  # ========================================================

  saveRDS(

    model_full,

    paste0(
      "SD_",
      trial_name,
      "_Poisson_model.rds"
    )
  )


  # ========================================================
  # RETURN
  # ========================================================

  list(

    data =
      d,

    model =
      model_full,

    null_model =
      model_null,

    overall =
      overall_test,

    emm =
      emm,

    dunnett =
      dunnett_results,

    dispersion_ratio =
      dispersion_ratio,

    dispersion_p =
      dispersion_p,

    singular =
      singular_fit
  )
}


# ==========================================================
# 7. RUN MODELS
# ==========================================================

hab_SD <- run_poisson_SD(
  df,
  "Hab"
)


social_SD <- run_poisson_SD(
  df,
  "Social"
)


novel_SD <- run_poisson_SD(
  df,
  "Novel"
)


# ==========================================================
# 8. DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

diagnostics_SD <- tibble(

  trial_type =
    c(
      "Hab",
      "Social",
      "Novel"
    ),

  dispersion_ratio =
    c(
      hab_SD$dispersion_ratio,
      social_SD$dispersion_ratio,
      novel_SD$dispersion_ratio
    ),

  dispersion_p =
    c(
      hab_SD$dispersion_p,
      social_SD$dispersion_p,
      novel_SD$dispersion_p
    ),

  singular_fit =
    c(
      hab_SD$singular,
      social_SD$singular,
      novel_SD$singular
    )
)


print(
  diagnostics_SD
)


write.csv(
  diagnostics_SD,
  "SD_Poisson_diagnostics.csv",
  row.names =
    FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 9. DUNNETT RESULTS
# ==========================================================

dunnett_SD <- bind_rows(

  as.data.frame(
    hab_SD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Hab"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    social_SD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Social"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    novel_SD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Novel"
    )

) %>%

  select(
    trial_type,
    everything()
  )


print(
  dunnett_SD
)


write.csv(
  dunnett_SD,
  "SD_Poisson_Dunnett_results.csv",
  row.names =
    FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 10. ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS
# ==========================================================

emm_SD <- bind_rows(

  as.data.frame(
    hab_SD$emm
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Hab"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    social_SD$emm
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Social"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    novel_SD$emm
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Novel"
    )

) %>%

  select(
    trial_type,
    everything()
  )


write.csv(
  emm_SD,
  "SD_Poisson_estimated_marginal_means.csv",
  row.names =
    FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. PLOT SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

plot_summary_SD <- df %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type,
    timepoint
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    mean_peaks =
      mean(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    sd_peaks =
      sd(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    n_mice =
      n_distinct(
        mouse_id
      ),

    sem_peaks =
      sd_peaks /
      sqrt(
        n_mice
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )


# ==========================================================
# 12. PREPARE P-VALUES FOR PLOT
# ==========================================================

p_SD <- bind_rows(

  as.data.frame(
    hab_SD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Hab"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    social_SD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Social"
    ),

  as.data.frame(
    novel_SD$dunnett
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      trial_type =
        "Novel"
    )

) %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    comparison_number =
      row_number()

  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  mutate(

    p_label =
      case_when(

        p.value <
          0.001 ~
          "p < .001",

        p.value <
          0.01 ~
          paste0(
            "p = ",
            sub(
              "^0",
              "",
              sprintf(
                "%.3f",
                p.value
              )
            )
          ),

        TRUE ~
          paste0(
            "p = ",
            sub(
              "^0",
              "",
              sprintf(
                "%.2f",
                p.value
              )
            )
          )
      )
  )


# ==========================================================
# 13. BRACKET HEIGHTS
# ==========================================================

plot_heights_SD <- df %>%

  group_by(
    trial_type
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    ymax =
      max(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    ymin =
      min(
        n_peaks,
        na.rm =
          TRUE
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    yrange =
      ymax -
      ymin,

    yrange =
      ifelse(
        yrange ==
          0,
        max(
          ymax *
            0.2,
          1
        ),
        yrange
      ),

    y_w1 =
      ymax +
      0.15 *
      yrange,

    y_w2 =
      ymax +
      0.40 *
      yrange

  )


p_SD <- p_SD %>%

  left_join(
    plot_heights_SD,
    by =
      "trial_type"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    x_start =
      1,

    x_end =
      ifelse(
        comparison_number ==
          1,
        2,
        3
      ),

    y_position =
      ifelse(
        comparison_number ==
          1,
        y_w1,
        y_w2
      ),

    text_x =
      (
        x_start +
        x_end
      ) /
      2,

    bracket_height =
      0.04 *
      yrange
  )


# ==========================================================
# 14. PLOT
# ==========================================================

plot_SD <- ggplot() +

  geom_line(

    data =
      df,

    aes(
      x =
        timepoint,
      y =
        n_peaks,
      group =
        mouse_id
    ),

    alpha =
      0.35,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(

    data =
      df,

    aes(
      x =
        timepoint,
      y =
        n_peaks
    ),

    size =
      2,

    alpha =
      0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(

    data =
      plot_summary_SD,

    aes(
      x =
        timepoint,
      y =
        mean_peaks
    ),

    size =
      4
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(

    data =
      plot_summary_SD,

    aes(

      x =
        timepoint,

      ymin =
        mean_peaks -
        sem_peaks,

      ymax =
        mean_peaks +
        sem_peaks

    ),

    width =
      0.1,

    linewidth =
      0.8
  ) +

  geom_segment(

    data =
      p_SD,

    aes(
      x =
        x_start,
      xend =
        x_end,
      y =
        y_position,
      yend =
        y_position
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  geom_segment(

    data =
      p_SD,

    aes(
      x =
        x_start,
      xend =
        x_start,
      y =
        y_position,
      yend =
        y_position -
        bracket_height
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  geom_segment(

    data =
      p_SD,

    aes(
      x =
        x_end,
      xend =
        x_end,
      y =
        y_position,
      yend =
        y_position -
        bracket_height
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    linewidth =
      0.5
  ) +

  geom_text(

    data =
      p_SD,

    aes(
      x =
        text_x,
      y =
        y_position +
        0.05 *
        yrange,
      label =
        p_label
    ),

    inherit.aes =
      FALSE,

    size =
      3.7
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ trial_type,
    scales =
      "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(

    expand =
      expansion(
        mult =
          c(
            0.05,
            0.30
          )
      )
  ) +

  labs(

    x =
      "Timepoint",

    y =
      "Number of detected transients",

    title =
      "SD-based transient counts"

  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size =
      13
  )


print(
  plot_SD
)


ggsave(

  filename =
    "SD_Poisson_peak_counts_with_Dunnett_pvalues.png",

  plot =
    plot_SD,

  width =
    10,

  height =
    4.5,

  dpi =
    300
)


cat(
  "\nSD ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n"
)
```
